lines.notes: North-South Corridor (Orange Line) extends 19.66 km with 18 stations in Phase 1, fully operational. Phase 2 extensions to Kanhan River (Reach 2B, 13 km, 12 stations) and Butibori MIDC (Reach 1A, 18.5 km, 10 stations) have foundation stone laid by PM (PIB PRID 1882434); 43.8 km / 32 stations breakdown sourced from official project profile (https://www.metrorailnagpur.com/nagpur-metro-project/project-profile).
